evaluation_method: Cluster RCT with multiple treatment arms
intervention_description: Multi-arm program providing productive grants, skills training, savings group support, and mentoring to extremely poor rural women

graduation_components_rationale.assets: Productive grant intended for asset/business investment
graduation_components_rationale.skills_training: 21-session life and business skills training provided
graduation_components_rationale.savings: Support to form savings groups included
graduation_components_rationale.coaching: Six months of group mentoring included
graduation_components_rationale.social_empowerment: No explicit social empowerment activities described

outcomes.outcome_name: Total household consumption per adult equivalent
outcomes.outcome_description: Household consumption per adult equivalent in standard deviations
outcomes.literal_text: Consumption increased by 0.44 standard deviations by 38 months

outcomes.outcome_description: Food security index in standard deviations
outcomes.literal_text: Food security index increased by 0.23 standard deviations at 38 months

outcomes.outcome_description: Asset wealth index in standard deviations
outcomes.literal_text: Asset wealth index increased by 0.28 standard deviations at 38 months

outcomes.outcome_description: Psychological well-being index in standard deviations
outcomes.literal_text: Psychological well-being index increased by 0.36 standard deviations at 38 months

outcomes.outcome_name: Time use: Paid work for others
